svg.title: Example order rows before and after the data-quality pipeline
svg.text: Real rows from the demo data: as they arrived (white) and what the pipeline made of them (grey).
extra spaces, letter case and agreed date formats; no approval needed
kept out of every total, listed with its file, line and reason
AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amount differs from unit price x quantity by more than the tolerance.
INVALID_QUANTITY: The quantity is not a whole number of at least the configured minimum.
compared after standardization, over all files, whatever order they arrive in
Identical orders: the first row is accepted, the copy is counted once.
Same order ID, different quantity and amount: both versions are held back until someone decides.
a suggested fix is applied only after a reviewer approves it
UNKNOWN_CHANNEL: the suggested “Web” waits for a reviewer; nothing changes until it is approved.
· marks a space at the start or end of a value. Generated by scripts/make-before-after.py from data/raw, data/late-batch and corrections/demo-decisions.csv.
